name: rcore-session-archive
description: Archives privacy-filtered coding-agent transcripts inside the local rCore checkout

interface.shortDescription: Keep a configurable local archive of each agent session.
interface.longDescription: Archives Codex and Claude Code sessions under .agent-sessions using a repository-local privacy mode: messages only, messages plus tool calls, or the full raw transcript.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me where this project archives coding-agent sessions.
